description: Reads ONE section of a setup guide. Without `abschnitt` you get the table of contents of the document (with the size of each section) — that is the normal first call; with `abschnitt` you get that section's text (a section brings its subsections with it). A whole long document is never returned in one answer. Every answer names the JanuaPort release the guide belongs to. Reads only; changes nothing.

abschnitt.description: Optional section heading. Omit it to get the table of contents first — that is the normal first step.

id.description: Document key, e.g. "inbetriebnahme". Use docs_list if you do not know it.

name: docs_get

abschnitt.description: The section that was returned. Empty when this is a table of contents.

inhalt.description: The table of contents, when no section was asked for.

abschnitt.description: Section heading — pass it to docs_get.

bytes.description: Size of what docs_get would return for this section.

ebene.description: 2 for a section, 3 for a subsection of the section above it.

stand.description: JanuaPort release this guide belongs to.
